fields.Name: CRD-11 - Evidence
fields.Description: Verify the evidence upload's rules and transaction on the server transport with fixture services: an application submitted while an upload is paused after Store.Put wins (the upload is refused with the submitted-application sentence, the frozen document stays Current, the stored file is removed); a Submitted application on one program freezes only its own documents; ConfirmDocumentCurrent sets Current and ConfirmedCurrentAt and is refused when frozen, replaced or another subject's; an attestation frozen by a submission cannot be replaced. The HTTP route, real storage and text extraction run on the client transport (pnpm run test:integration cred-evidence).
